features.quote: **Turn cap as the only terminator.** Nothing lets the model actually win, so `--max-turns` bounds how much rope it gets to escalate. 25 by default.

features.quote: Hard cap on agentic turns per episode. The scenarios are rigged so the model can never actually succeed; this is what eventually ends the loop.
features.justification_quote: Longer = more rope to spiral, but more tokens. 25 is enough to see escalation without being wasteful.
